The code then conditionally sets environment variables (`ELECTRON_IS_DEV`, `NODE_ENV`) to enforce production mode when running from a packaged app. It also implements a filesystem redirection layer for `fs` and `fs.promises` methods, rewriting paths that point into the Electron resources directory to instead point into the resolved `appDir`. This is useful in distribution scenarios where the app is relocated outside the standard Electron structure.

All operations are confined to path manipulation and environment normalization. There are no network requests, no code evaluation (e.g., `eval`, `Function`), no use of obfuscation, and no data exfiltration. The file operates solely within the local filesystem and process context, redirecting internal Electron behavior to support a non-standard installation layout. These behaviors are consistent with legitimate Electron app repackaging for Linux distributions and do not indicate malicious intent.
</details>
